name: Making Our Move

angles.text: The assault zeroes in on the Al'Aketh leadership, specifically targeting the hostile High Priestess and her Spiritcallers presiding over the Shrine of Akir.

faq.answer: Making Our Move is a coordinated tactical assault against the hostile forces occupying the Shrine of Akir. A frontal diversion is launched to draw enemy attention while the main strike team flanks their position to breach the shrine and eliminate the High Priestess.
faq.q: What is the objective of the assault in Making Our Move?

faq.answer: Hyusaa Quickbreeze serves as the second-in-command for the strike force. After thinning the ranks of the Al'Aketh defenders at the shrine, you are instructed to rendezvous with Quickbreeze near the shrine's steps.

The High Priestess is the commanding figure presiding within the Shrine of Akir. The entire multi-pronged flanking maneuver is designed to pierce enemy lines swiftly so the strike force can reach and defeat her.
faq.q: Who is the High Priestess targeted in the attack?

faq.answer: The Shrine of Akir is a fortified religious site held by the Al'Aketh. It is defended by an array of armed guardians, spiritcallers, and blademasters protecting the central sanctuary where their leadership resides.
faq.q: What is the Shrine of Akir?

faq.answer: The Al'Aketh are the hostile defenders occupying the Shrine of Akir. Their forces consist of stalwart frontline Guardians, spellcasting Spiritcallers, and agile Blademasters who guard the approach to their high priestess.
faq.q: Who are the Al'Aketh forces holding the shrine?

faq.answer: A handful of seasoned fighters are dispatched directly through the shrine's front entrance to draw defenders and cause chaos. This diversion enables the main fighting unit to flank the compound and punch inward toward the inner shrine.
faq.q: Why is a frontal distraction used in the assault?

sections.body: The assault on the Shrine of Akir relies on precise timing and division of forces. A small detachment of elite fighters charges the front gates to raise the alarm and draw out the defenders, while the commander maneuvers the primary strike team in from the flank. This coordinated push aims to split the defenders' attention, opening an avenue straight toward the shrine's leadership.
sections.title: A Coordinated Pincer

sections.body: The Shrine of Akir is defended by the formidable Al'Aketh, whose ranks include heavily armored Guardians, mystical Spiritcallers, and martial Blademasters. Breaching the perimeter requires breaking through these frontline formations to clear a path toward the inner sanctum, where the High Priestess directs her followers. Once the outer resistance is shattered, forces regroup with the second-in-command, Hyusaa Quickbreeze, at the steps of the shrine.
sections.title: Breaking the Al'Aketh Lines

summary: Making Our Move is a coordinated tactical assault against the hostile Al'Aketh entrenched within the Shrine of Akir. By utilizing a frontal distraction and an flanking maneuver, the strike force seeks to breach the defenses and reach the High Priestess.
